title: [26.22] Reworked Shyvana // Jungle Guide
author: Oikaton

RekSai.summary: She wins dark early river skirmishes. Only fight her when your lanes can move to help; otherwise trade objectives on the opposite side.

Warwick.summary: He wants long, messy early fights and you don't. Keep clearing, skip ego duels, and beat him later through tempo and objectives.

Belveth.summary: Don't give her free early skirmishes or grubs; one cashed objective fight makes the map much harder to control.

Poppy.summary: Her W blocks your R dash completely, so don't let her cancel your engage in narrow jungle chokes. Play cross-map instead.

Nunu.summary: Don't flip river fights or objectives into his burst and snowball. When he shows somewhere, punish lanes and camps instead of racing him in the pit.

XinZhao.summary: Beats you in early short-range all-ins. If your lanes can't help, avoid his invade route and trade camps.

Briar.summary: Her forced engage turns messy fights her way. Kite her first commit, don't chase into fog, and buy armor earlier.

Hecarim.summary: Don't give him long run-ups through open river. Ward entrances early and fight after his first charge is spent.

Rammus.summary: Don't tunnel him through taunt and his anti-auto armor. Farm the opposite side, keep tempo, and hit targets he can't protect.

Udyr.summary: He matches your clear and wins early stand-and-fight duels. Avoid straight early 1v1s unless you have numbers.

Olaf.summary: Wins the first long all-in if you stand still. Break his axe rhythm, kite his first run and don't take early river fights into him.

Pantheon.summary: Respect his early invades and point-and-click setup. If he doesn't snowball early, your clear and neutrals outscale him.

Nidalee.summary: Dodge her spear first, then force close range; tight terrain suits you far better than open river.

Rengar.summary: Don't face-check isolated brush. Ward entrances, fight near teammates, and don't give him the first leap.

Kindred.summary: Track her marks and don't fight on ranged terms; save damage or E timing for when her ult zone ends.

Darius.summary: Never give him an early stand-still fight at five stacks. Kite his opener and make him choose between camps and lanes.

Graves.summary: Whoever gets first space owns the tempo, but one clean E in tighter terrain flips the fight quickly.

Viego.summary: The danger is his reset, not the first trade. Kill cleanly or leave before he can possess someone.

Vi.summary: Track when her point-and-click ult can reach you or your carry; save W for her commit, not before.

Nocturne.summary: Respect his first hard engage, then win the longer front-to-back fight once he runs out of tools.

MonkeyKing.summary: Don't dump damage into his clone or stack for a double knock-up. Make him reveal the real body, then re-engage.

LeeSin.summary: Real early pressure, but if he whiffs his early tempo it gets much easier. Keep your route clean and punish failed plays.

Diana.summary: Avoid clumping and track her engage angle; if she has to dive first, your counter-hit and follow-up are easier.

Lillia.summary: If she gets room to kite, the fight goes bad fast. Force tight spaces, make every E count, and don't chase into open fog.

JarvanIV.summary: Track his flag-and-drag and Flash angles; don't burn dragon form into his first engage. After his opener, fights get simpler.

Amumu.summary: He wants you lined up for a free engage. Fight spread out, avoid blind entrances and keep moving after the first bandage.

Khazix.summary: Don't isolate yourself around dark camps; with vision and nearby allies this matchup gets much better.

Elise.summary: Respect cocoon and her early burst. Counter-ganks and opposite-side trades beat blind early 1v1s.

Kayn.summary: Punish him before he transforms and track his wall exits. Once he has his form, armor and front-to-back fighting matter more than greedy chases.

Ekko.summary: Track his W and don't overchase into his rewind zone; if he uses his ult early, re-entering is much easier.

Gwen.summary: Don't waste form or E into her mist; wait it out, then stick to her when she has no room to kite.

Taliyah.summary: Respect her worked ground and wall angles around river; if you break through her zone first she dies fast.

Evelynn.summary: You win early tempo and she wins later in fog. Press camps and dragons early, then buy vision and stop walking into dark lanes.

Skarner.summary: Sweep flanks and respect his charge and ult angles; if he spends his first engage on the wrong target the fight improves for you.

Zac.summary: Control vision near walls and be ready for his second engage, not just the first jump; he's much weaker when he can't surprise you.

Gragas.summary: His displacement is annoying but he's squishy if caught. Dodge his E and R, then run him down; don't let him disengage free.

Volibear.summary: Kite his first burst and keep hitting; his early game is strong but you scale better into objectives and long fights.

Sejuani.summary: Don't give her free melee proc chains; once her first CC is down you outdamage her and take neutrals faster.

Trundle.summary: Refuse bad early pillar fights, then beat him with better target access and objective control.

Maokai.summary: Don't walk first into sapling zones; if you reach the space first you outdamage him and take neutrals faster.

Shen.summary: Outclear and out-take him. Track his taunt and cross-map ult and punish every time he leaves his camps.

DrMundo.summary: Don't waste form chasing him through his ult; hit the nearest target, win neutral tempo and cut him off the map.

Malphite.summary: Front-to-back fights favor you as long as you don't throw away form chasing past him.

Aatrox.summary: Avoid his sweet spots and long bleed-out skirmishes; if his first Q cycle misses, your sustained hits win.

Karthus.summary: He folds if you touch him first. Only invade with lane priority; otherwise beat him by owning dragons and first setup.

Fiddlesticks.summary: Sweep vision and deny flank fog so he must walk in from normal angles; owning the objective first ruins his engage.

Sylas.summary: Deny him free value from your ult and punish his slower clear; your first item and neutral control are usually stronger.

Talon.summary: When he shows early, take camps, dragon or catch his exits; don't let his wall roams dictate your tempo.

Shaco.summary: Don't waste time fighting boxes and clones; keep tempo and drag him into real objective fights.

MasterYi.summary: Don't give him resets; if you survive his first touch and keep him in front of you, structured fights favor you.

Qiyana.summary: Avoid fighting on river or wall terms; flatter ground shrinks her burst windows.

Zed.summary: Armor and vision remove most of the threat. Hold W for his re-entry and don't let him farm side control freely.

Jayce.summary: Fragile and tempo-based; reach him through fog or objective setup and he can't handle the long fight.

Brand.summary: Dies fast if you reach him cleanly; just don't start the fight already chunked or in narrow space.

Morgana.summary: Sidestep her Q, bait out her black shield early, then run through her; she can't win first contact.

Ivern.summary: Hit his camps and timers, not Daisy; if he sets up a shielded front line first, the fight drags too long.

Zyra.summary: Don't path blindly through plant chokepoints; if you hit first or flank with vision she folds quickly.

general: Jungle guide. Max Q (Q-E-W early) and default to a full clear: arrive at the 2:55 scuttle healthy and only contest it with lane help or priority, since empty pre-form Shyvana is a weak river fighter. Gank early only when a lane is overextended, lacks Flash or has hard CC to follow your E. Levels 1-5 are a warm-up; level 6 (around the second clear) brings the first real dragon-form fights, the first item (Kraken Slayer) makes her strong, and 2-3 items is her peak, roughly 14-28 minutes. Build Fury on camps before objectives so you arrive near 80-100, set up the first dragon around 4:30-5:00 only with bot/mid priority, and don't press R just because the bar is full. Late game she is volatile: engage only on guaranteed angles, guard your form timer and play around Baron and Elder.
